name: Science
description: The Science Department offers Biology, Chemistry, and Physics at both O-Level and A-Level. Our state-of-the-art laboratories provide hands-on practical experience.

name: Humanities
description: The Humanities Department covers History, Geography, and Christian Religious Education, fostering critical thinking and cultural awareness.

name: Creative Arts
description: The Creative Arts Department offers Art and Design, Music, and Physical Education, nurturing creativity, expression, and physical development.

name: Languages
description: The Languages Department offers English Language, Literature in English, French, and Luganda, promoting communication skills and cultural appreciation.

name: Business Studies
description: The Business Studies Department offers Commerce, Economics, and Entrepreneurship, preparing students for careers in business and finance.

name: ICT
description: The ICT Department offers Computer Studies and practical digital skills, preparing students for the technology-driven world.

name: Mathematics
description: The Mathematics Department develops logical reasoning, problem-solving, and analytical skills through a comprehensive mathematics curriculum.
